messages:
Sara: OMG @Evan just proposed to Jamie last night!! :ring: :tada: They said YES!!
Evan: hey all — yep, totally true. she said yes ❤️ thanks for the love. still buzzing.
Olivia: CONGRATS!!!!! This is the best news :confetti_ball: when's the party??
Evan: no official date yet. thinking late summer maybe. probably a small thing at the office or backyard.
Ralph: cake or pizza debate begins. my vote: both. :pizza: + :cake: :grin:
Maya: cake + gluten-free option pls. or a donut wall? :donut:
Sara: quick poll — react with 🎂 for cake, 🍕 for pizza, 🥂 for drinks-only. i'll tally and start planning.
DevBot: Reminder set: create #evan-jamie-celebration channel draft in 3 days. (automated)
Olivia: i can bring decorations and a playlist. gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-cheer-3oEduSbSGpGaRX2Vri
Ralph: i'll grab balloons and a banner. i have a tiny soldering torch but promise not to use it on the banner this time.
Maya: also, any accessibility or dietary needs we should collect now? Evan, want me to DM you a quick RSVP form?
Evan: yes please, that would be amazing — thanks maya. and honestly we love the tiny-banner-torch idea ?? lol.
Sara: also, who wants to be on cake/pizza duty? i'll volunteer organizer hat (not the soldering torch). :raised_hands:
Olivia: me for playlists.
Ralph: me for food pickup shift A.
Maya: i'll do dietary list & GF cake ordering.
Evan: you folks are the best. can't wait to celebrate with everyone. :smiling_face_with_3_hearts:
Sara: congrats again @Evan & @Jamie!! :sparkles: :tada:
